title: What are the guidelines for creating a user name in Google Workspace?
content:
Q: What are the guidelines for creating a user name in Google Workspace?
A: To create a user name in Google Workspace, follow these guidelines:

- User names can be between 1 and 64 characters in length.
- User names may contain any of the following: letters (a - z), numbers (0 - 9), dashes (-), underscores (_), apostrophes ('), and periods (.).
- User names may **not** contain any of the following: ampersands (&), equal signs (=), brackets (< >), plus signs (+), commas (,), or more than one period (.) in a row.

title: How does Wix use IndexNow to inform search engines about changes to my site?
content:
Q: How does Wix use IndexNow to inform search engines about changes to my site?
A: Wix uses IndexNow to instantly alert search engines, like Bing and Yandex, about any changes made on your website, making crawling more efficient. The IndexNow functionality is included with your Premium plan. Wix checks when there are changes to your site pages and submits the changes on your behalf to the IndexNow protocol. This allows search engines to quickly identify that a page was changed and reflect the change in search results. Normally, it can take time for search engines to crawl and index your site, but with a Premium site, Wix automatically makes IndexNow aware of any site changes without you having to keep on top of it. For example, if you add a new blog post to your site, Wix notifies IndexNow, and IndexNow then pings relevant search engines about the changes. This allows the search engines to crawl and index the page faster (depending on their indexing factors).

Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/how-wix-uses-indexnow-to-inform-search-engines-about-your-site-changes

title: How can I customize text carried over from the desktop version in the Wix mobile editor?

title: How does Wix's Smart Algorithm optimize Facebook ad campaigns?
content:
Q: How does Wix's Smart Algorithm optimize Facebook ad campaigns?
A: Wix's Smart Algorithm optimizes Facebook ad campaigns by using advanced data science algorithms and a lot of data. Here's how it works:

- **Audiences**: The decision-making engine creates more variations of Lookalikes, engagement, and remarketing audiences. It measures their potential reach and performance using data from the business’ Facebook Page, pixel, and campaign stats.

- **Targeting**: It takes users’ predefined targeting and breaks it down into age, gender, locations, interests, and placements in Facebook and Instagram. It measures the effectiveness of each and decides when to broaden the audience, break it down, or take no action. The best audiences with the highest potential for conversion are chosen, while low-quality audiences are paused.

- **Ad Sets**: The algorithm pauses ad sets with negative trends, low quality, low conversion rate, or low engagement rank. It resumes ad sets with new potential signals based on new engaging insights from the campaign or pixel.

The algorithm runs daily analyses of every change in campaign performance from Facebook and Instagram, combined with data from your website. It uses this data to run unique decision-making models and trend analyses, simulating and estimating the effectiveness of each action to fine-tune the campaign.

Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-about-wixs-smart-algorithm

title: How can I customize the settings of my gallery in ADI?
content:
Q: How can I customize the settings of my gallery in ADI?
A: Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added a gallery to your site and added media to it.

To customize your gallery settings:

1. Click your gallery in the ADI builder.
2. Customize your gallery settings on the panel on the left using the available options:
   
   * **Full Width:** Switch on the toggle to expand your gallery across the width of your site.
   * **Load More Button:** Switch on the toggle to show a 'Load More' button for galleries with more items than fit in the section layout.
   * **Image Ratio:** Select a ratio of the gallery items. The images automatically update on the page so you can see how it looks.
   * **When Clicking On an Item:** Click the drop-down to select what happens when visitors click a gallery item:
     
     + **A Link Opens:** Visitors are directed to a link (a web address, page, lightbox, etc.)
     
     **Note:** To set up a link click **Manage Media** beneath the drop-down.
     + **Nothing Happens:** Nothing happens when someone clicks an item.
     + **Open in Full Screen:** The gallery item expands in fullscreen mode so visitors can get a closer look.
   * **Display Elements:** Select the elements to include in the gallery alongside the gallery items.
     
     + **Image Title:** Display the title of the gallery item. **Note**: Click **Manage Media** at the bottom to update your titles.
     + **Image Description:** Include the description of the item. **Note**: Click **Manage Media** at the bottom to update the item description.
     + **Social Sharing:** Add social media icons to your gallery items so visitors can share the media.
     + **Download:** Add a download icon beside each gallery item so visitors can download your media.
     + **Heart Icon:** Add a heart icon so visitors can react to their favorite gallery items.
   * **Image Quality:** Drag the slider to change the image quality.
   * **Image Sharpening:** Select the checkmark to sharpen your image using the amount, radius and threshold controls.

**Note:** Some settings may be different or unavailable based on the gallery layout you choose.

Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/adi-adding-and-setting-up-a-gallery

title: How can I update the prices and availability for my rooms using Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content:
Q: How can I update the prices and availability for my rooms using Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
A: To update the prices and availability for your rooms using Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, you can use the **Inventory Calendar** tab. Here, you can make changes to the availability and price rates for each of your rooms as required. You can filter the calendar view by Room type, Rate plan, or Channels.

For price or availability updates to multiple rooms at once, use the **Bulk Updates** tab. Here you can update your rooms, rate plans, and prices in bulk. Filter the view by Rate plan, by channel, or both.

Choose what you want to update from the following options:

* **Base Price:** Update base price rates for a given period of time. Choose between a fixed monetary adjustment or a percentage adjustment.
* **Availability:** Update how many rooms of a certain type you have available. Make sure this new number is accurate to avoid over-bookings.
* **Minimum stay:** Encourage longer stays by setting a minimum stay restriction. This is useful during high season.
* **Stop Sell:** Block the sale of certain rates for a period of time. This is useful during low seasons.
* **Closed to arrival:** Restrict guests from arriving on specific dates. This is useful during holidays to better manage your staff’s workload.
* **Closed to departure:** Restrict guests from departing on specific dates. This is useful to better manage your staff’s workload.

Then select the relevant start and end dates, and specific days of the week you want to update.

Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-hotels-by-hotelrunner-an-overview

* **The amounts are in different currencies:** Depending on your location, the amount listed on your Wix invoice may be displayed in US dollars (for example, in Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Argentina, Israel or Singapore). The amount you see on your bank statement will be in your local currency.

* **You have been charged bank fees:** Your bank may charge additional processing fees for your payment. For example, a transaction fee or a currency conversion fee.

**Note:** Bank fees or exchange rates are not determined or controlled by Wix.

title: What proactive measures does Wix take to moderate content under the Digital Services Act?
content:
Q: What proactive measures does Wix take to moderate content under the Digital Services Act?
A: Wix undertakes voluntary investigations aiming to identify and act against illegal content by applying a combination of automated tools and human review to proactively moderate content on our platform. Our automated tools are designed to make our best efforts in trying to identify specific illegal activities, such as:

* **Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM):** Once identified, our team of trained moderators reviews and, if necessary, takes action on suspicious content.
* **Phishers and Fraudster Behaviour:** Based on specific patterns, we strive to identify accounts that have the primary purpose of conducting any form of web forgery. This includes publishing malicious websites or tricking visitors into giving up sensitive information such as passwords, account details, or credit card numbers.

Source: https://support.wix.com/en/article/digital-services-act-notice-on-content-moderation-and-user-numbers
